title: European twist of mall world
content: In my understanding the mallworld is something that people go to and it has often some similiarities with your living surroundings in real life. I used AI to get some pictures of the mallworld I go to. It has 90's east european vibes and the toilet is often this Harry Potter-esque 1800 century trainstation vibe. It has something to do with the fact that I'm a millennial and the toilets in public spaces in my surroundings are often at trainstations/old small malls(gallery)/ old buildings. In my childhood my family often traveled, so there is sometimes the US-mall section too that is much bigger and more like the ones othet have too, but the train station is clearly a more european vibe. Not yet found there any big car parks or parking houses. Everything is much smaller and the dark small corners are scary. And there is often people just silently watching. Sorry my english is a bit bad, not a native englishspeaker.
